name: Single Card
description: A simple one-card reading for quick daily guidance or insight into a specific question.

positions.name: The Card
positions.description: Your guidance for today or answer to your question
positions.interpretationGuide: Focus on the card's primary meaning and how it relates to the querent's current situation or question.

name: Three Card Spread
description: A versatile three-card spread that can represent Past-Present-Future or Situation-Action-Outcome.

positions.name: Past / Situation
positions.description: The foundation or background of the situation
positions.interpretationGuide: Examine what has led to the current moment. What influences from the past are still affecting you?

positions.name: Present / Action
positions.description: The current state or recommended action
positions.interpretationGuide: What is happening right now? What action should be taken?

positions.name: Future / Outcome
positions.description: The likely outcome or future direction
positions.interpretationGuide: Where is this path leading? What is the potential outcome if current course continues?

name: Love Triangle
description: A three-card spread specifically designed for love and relationship questions.

positions.name: You
positions.description: Your position and feelings in the relationship
positions.interpretationGuide: What are you bringing to this relationship? What are your true feelings?

positions.name: The Other
positions.description: The other person's position and feelings
positions.interpretationGuide: What is the other person feeling? What is their perspective?

positions.name: The Relationship
positions.description: The nature and potential of the relationship
positions.interpretationGuide: What is the essence of this relationship? Where is it heading?

name: Career Path
description: A five-card spread for career guidance and professional development questions.

positions.name: Current Position
positions.description: Your current career situation
positions.interpretationGuide: Where are you now in your career? What defines your current professional state?

positions.name: Strengths
positions.description: Your professional strengths and assets
positions.interpretationGuide: What skills and talents can you leverage? What are your professional advantages?

positions.name: Challenges
positions.description: Obstacles or challenges to overcome
positions.interpretationGuide: What stands in your way? What challenges must you address?

positions.name: Advice
positions.description: Guidance for moving forward
positions.interpretationGuide: What action should you take? What approach will serve you best?

positions.name: Potential Outcome
positions.description: The likely result of following this path
positions.interpretationGuide: Where will this lead? What can you expect if you follow this guidance?

name: Celtic Cross
description: The classic ten-card spread offering comprehensive insight into complex situations.

positions.name: Present
positions.description: The current situation or question
positions.interpretationGuide: What is the heart of the matter? What defines the present moment?

positions.name: Challenge
positions.description: The immediate challenge or obstacle
positions.interpretationGuide: What crosses or opposes you? What is the immediate challenge to face?

positions.name: Foundation
positions.description: The basis or root of the situation
positions.interpretationGuide: What is beneath this? What are the underlying factors?

positions.name: Recent Past
positions.description: Recent events that are passing
positions.interpretationGuide: What has just happened? What is moving into the past?

positions.name: Crown
positions.description: Potential or what crowns you
positions.interpretationGuide: What is possible? What are you moving towards?

positions.name: Near Future
positions.description: What is coming into being
positions.interpretationGuide: What is approaching? What will manifest soon?

positions.name: Your Approach
positions.description: Your attitude or approach to the situation
positions.interpretationGuide: How are you handling this? What is your position or attitude?

positions.name: External Influences
positions.description: External factors and people affecting the situation
positions.interpretationGuide: What external forces are at play? Who or what influences this situation?

positions.name: Hopes and Fears
positions.description: Your hopes, fears, or expectations
positions.interpretationGuide: What do you hope for or fear? What are your expectations?

positions.name: Final Outcome
positions.description: The ultimate outcome
positions.interpretationGuide: Where does this all lead? What is the final outcome?
